review_title: Prático e intuitivo, merece um melhor aspeto.
pros: É de uso intuitivo e muito prático. Desde o estado em que se encontra a tarefa até à facilidade de classificação. Entra-se na aplicação e rapidamente se percebe o estado em que as tarefas estão. A possibilidade de divisão por equipas também é muito útil.
cons: Do aspeto, podia ser mais agradável à vista, mais clean.
general_comments: Estou satisfeita e vou continuar a usar.

review_title: Where or where did my old Asana go? It went greedy.
pros: It used to have an ease of use. Very vitually appealing and easy for staff to follow. I also enjoyed the Celebration Creatures.
cons: Since developing a paid version, more and more functions have been stripped from the paid one. And the paid version is incredibly expensive for a small, independent business. The search function is impossible, you can't get rid of detritus, etc. I can no longer recommend them.
general_comments: It used to be very positive, not it is just a money-hungry disappointment.
reasons_for_choosing: We were happy with its ease of use and accommodation to small companies.

pros: I like that Asana is so customizable to your needs. I can make task tracking as simple or unique as I want which is so great since projects have different needs.
cons: Although a powerful tool, it can feel overwhelming at times to know which setup/functionality will work for the project/task at hand.
general_comments: I use Asana often and collaborate with my team and other business units on those tasks. I can easily tag, comment, and link. I love being able to keep things all in one place. The project overview page is a super awesome feature that allows a quick glance before a deep dive.

pros: With Asana I can assign tasks, set deadlines and divide big projects into small steps. The collaboration is very helpful, anyone can comment on tasks directly.
cons: It can feel overwhelming at start because there is a lot of features. The mobile app is not very smooth.

review_title: Asana- a great tool for project management and team collaboration
pros: I love Asana's intuitive interface and powerful project management features, making task tracking and team collaboration seamless.
cons: pricing model can be a bit steep for smaller teams, and some features feel limited in the free version.
general_comments: My overall experience with Asana has been positive, as it effectively streamlines project management and enhances team collaboration.
